=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:10978-11124 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new #9533 repeated-reviewer-failure tests are defined after `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())`, so plain `python3` runs exit before the tests are defined and never collect them.
  WHY: CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml:3828), mark-stable.yml and test-and-mark-stable.yml run this file with plain python3, so the in-run block, failure-comment and workflow-wiring tests never run and regressions ship green. Severity disagreement: gemini and minimax rated BLOCKER, sonnet, luna and glm rated MAJOR; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1213-1225, 4407-4419, 4573-4581 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: No security-pass step maps `vars.SECURITY_PASS_BASE_SYNC_CARRY_ENABLED` into its `env:` block, and scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh reads the variable with default `true` (line 364).
  WHY: The kill switch documented in README and the changelog has no effect, so base-sync heads keep being marked clean without an audit and auto-merge keeps being released.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36538-36550 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `repeated_reviewer_failure` skip in `_issueless_review_retry_decide` checks head, reason and fp but not `$prior_fail.support`, and it is evaluated before the `waiting_for_release`/support checks.
  WHY: The issue-less retry only runs under a new support SHA, and the gate's count drops markers from other support versions (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:5357). The in-run block therefore never fires: run 2 posts "will retry" with no label, and the poller then skips the PR silently forever, even after a fixing release. This contradicts spec item 2, and the test passes only because both markers use OLD_SUPPORT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36549-36550 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The poller's repeated-failure skip is unconditional and ignores `REVIEW_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_CAP_ENABLED`, which the in-run block does check (scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:145).
  WHY: With the cap disabled, the review run posts "will retry" but the issue-less pass still skips the PR, so the documented off switch does not restore retries on this path. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated NIT, the others rated MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_workflow_failure.sh:39-45 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new early `exit 0` when `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON` is exactly `[]` labels only the PR and skips the `LINKED_ISSUE_FALLBACK_NUMBERS_JSON` fallback (lines 47-49) and the PR body/title fallback (lines 51-66/51-67).
  WHY: A PR whose closingIssuesReferences is empty but whose body says "Closes #N" never gets issue #N labelled ai:review-blocked, so the review-blocked judge, the stall poller and the orchestrator state machine miss the block.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:440-443 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `single_pass_base_sync_carry` treats equal `git patch-id --stable` values as proof that the PR's file diffs are unchanged, but patch-id ignores whitespace unless `--verbatim` is used.
  WHY: A semantically meaningful whitespace change (YAML indentation, Python re-indent) inside the merge gives the same patch-id, so the head is carried clean (reason=base_sync_carry) without an audit. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated NIT because exploitation is limited to the pipeline-marked web-flow merge commit, the others rated MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:153-154 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The carry's marker parser (`awk '$4 == head { m = $0 } END { if (m != "") print m }'`) picks the newest marker that names the current head, not the newest trusted base-sync marker overall.
  WHY: A head reset or rebased onto an older sync merge can have the older marker accepted and its clean audit carried without auditing the reset content. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this claim and reported it not confirmed: in its reading, the base-parent containment check at review_head_gate.sh:195-206 makes the scenario fail closed.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:111-121 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The autofix-failure-fingerprint call uses different evidence inputs from the assemble-failure-evidence step: it omits `--evidence-file "${RUNTIME_DIR}/resolver_stage_stderr.txt"`, which assemble_failure_evidence.sh line 69 includes.
  WHY: The two fingerprints can differ, so the gate's identical-failure count and the poller's same-fp check mismatch and a repeated crash does not trigger the block. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion, noting that it predates the PR.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:330-453 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `mktemp -d` directory carry_tmp in `single_pass_base_sync_carry` is not removed on every early-return or error path (minimax cites lines 360-384).
  WHY: Leftover temp directories holding comments JSON, file lists and patch-id scratch files pile up on long-lived runners. This is not a correctness failure.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4043-4057 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `reviewer_failure_evidence` deduplicates bash diagnostics by exact string match only.
  WHY: Near-identical diagnostics can fill REVIEWER_FAILURE_HELPER_LINES_MAX and hide the true root cause.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4043-4057, 4900-4911 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `reviewer_failure_evidence` drops a plain `ERROR: <message>` line, so it never reaches the evidence file read by the fingerprint and by the `failure-headline` `_PLAIN_ERROR_LINE_RE` fallback (scripts/review_autofix_step_assemble_failure_evidence.sh:13-18).
  WHY: A reviewer crash that prints only `ERROR: ...` produces empty evidence, an fp with no cause and no First error line, which reproduces the item-3 symptom (empty `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR`).
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:142 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `GATE_HEAD_SHA_FOR_FINGERPRINT:-${AUTOFIX_FAILURE_HEAD_SHA:-}` falls back to this run's own head when the gate head is unset, so the same-head check passes trivially.
  WHY: If the gate head wiring regresses, the block no longer verifies the head and can block a different head's retry on a stale fingerprint. Defaulting to empty would fail closed. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: "Name the error. Fill AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR from the reviewer step's first ERROR/bash diagnostic line"

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: reviewer_failure_evidence keeps only bash diagnostics (_normalise_bash_diagnostic) and self-named script lines (moving from the bash-diagnostic check at 4046-4054 to the self-named-script check at 4055-4059), so a plain `ERROR:` line in reviewers_stage_stderr.txt is dropped; the `failure-headline` plain-error fallback (4910-4911, _PLAIN_ERROR_LINE_RE) sees only that filtered evidence file (fed by scripts/review_autofix_step_assemble_failure_evidence.sh line 16), so the line never reaches AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR or the fingerprint; the bash-diagnostic half is implemented

  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh _issueless_review_retry_decide / run_issueless_review_retry_pass (retry dispatch loop)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: the poller change only adds a silent `skipped|repeated_reviewer_failure` decision (lines 36549-36550), and no hunk on that path labels the PR or posts the block comment, while the in-run block cannot fire on the poller's cross-support retry because counts are scoped per support version, so no step ever labels issue-less PRs or posts the one blocking comment

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (security-pass step env blocks, lines 1220, 4414 and 4577); variable read in scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh single_pass_base_sync_carry | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: README and the changelog document `SECURITY_PASS_BASE_SYNC_CARRY_ENABLED=false` as the kill switch, but no `SECURITY_PASS_BASE_SYNC_CARRY_ENABLED: ${{ vars.SECURITY_PASS_BASE_SYNC_CARRY_ENABLED || 'true' }}` line exists anywhere under .github/workflows.
  WHY: The script default `true` always applies, so base-sync heads keep being marked clean and auto-merge keeps being released; the suggested fix is to add the mapping next to SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS and check the size with `wc -c`.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:single_pass_base_sync_carry (carry_patch_audited / carry_patch_head `git patch-id --stable` lines) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: patch-id strips whitespace unless `--verbatim` is used, so equal ids do not prove the PR's lines are byte-identical.
  WHY: A whitespace-only change is marked clean (reason=base_sync_carry). Exploitation is limited to the pipeline-marked, web-flow-verified update commit. The suggested fix is `--verbatim`, failing closed (patch_mismatch) if the flag is unsupported.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36549-36550 (_issueless_review_retry_decide; cf. 36554, 36506-36510) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The repeated_reviewer_failure skip does not compare `support`. The retry always runs under a new support SHA and the gate's count drops other-support markers (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py ~5357), so GATE_FINGERPRINT_CAP_COUNT is 0 and the in-run block (scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh lines 144-152) never fires.
  WHY: Run 2 posts "will retry" with no label, then the poller skips the PR silently forever, even after a fixing @stable release; this contradicts spec item 2, and the test passes only because both markers use OLD_SUPPORT. The suggested fix is to require `$prior_fail.support == $f.support`, or to label and comment instead of skipping.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_workflow_failure.sh:39-45 (before fallbacks 47-49, 51-66) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON` is `[]`, the script labels only the PR and exits without consulting the fallback numbers or the "Closes #N" body fallback.
  WHY: The linked issue never gets ai:review-blocked, so the judge and the issue-label state machine miss the block. The
